book.name: AROGAMENI
book.title: AROGAMENI Iesu Keriso Dion arogameni noa

content: Amba anea dawa aro baware denawa kimani visiwandini bet inana gapan yawan. Irikup da wanup umap ikukuk panen koa iap tau aen. Gine namu wam ganasewa umap. Pusiwa airaniwa nononga dere merao umap.
Ok otu da viri viri warane wat vese nanip waren. Pusiwa nutup puimani amun pusiwa senip piupa amun.
Man puawa laion gururut waini umap ve baware wan. Wani gare kimani nop nani yamu dere tauan.
Nop ame tauane ne ok seapen tana go kiman gapan nop da sia anega taue watananegen, “Kimani nop nani yamu dere tauane ok ya se karaua wandep.”
Anea puimani piupa amuni apanewa ne yawan naniwa nutup nop wapen men kimani ao waren.

God wan kiman gwanape den venat mutan sia wan piup gwanape den venat mutan sia wan puiman gwanape den venat mutan. God yaibobot wandini apanewa ameme amun mega gapan anea kaimakaet agi anega wan, “Wam usira entutnagene ame uon tan.
Anea nani yamu derewa pum mega upunepi God nop mega tavewa di taueta. God nop mega ame gungunua wandeni ame God me ago mega nagirewa ame watageta oit mega waiwanumune nagirewa, ame wadiamoni.”
Nop kiman gapan namu inanap taueni sia tauen, anega wan, “Ge ak anea puimani piupa amuni apanewa ok wat vese nanip wareni waseat.”
Wani angena ok otu koentu viri viri warane ameme nenapen mup wan. Anea anega wadianegen, “Ok wat na. Nawa nogap danse den onaro mini anu go bagugap visepi gapan sisi den anui.”
Wani ne ok nanip waran nan. Nonap na yawana danse den iwat mini go na kauamena baguna gapan sisi wan.
Nana amba orup da wadianegen, “God nop oit mega at at, dugup dugup amba nop ugup ugupe nagirewa, ayop muga den aigap sia wadiamoi.”
